scientific_integrity: Exact finite-dimensional spectral proof; independent audit unperformed; historical priority provisional and possible equivalent consequences of graph heat-kernel centrality literature remain a risk.
scientific_limitations: Explicit family only, with combinatorial Laplacian, a full counting-measure Fourier basis, and unscaled heat atoms. No classification of all irregular graphs, no graph-size minimality, no perturbation stability. The first-public date refers to the focal 2024 source, not publication of this result.
title: Transient exact tightness of heat-kernel graph Gabor frames on irregular clique joins
